parsed.scene_description: A warehouse interior with tall orange metal shelving units filled with cardboard boxes. An orange and black forklift is parked on the concrete floor near pallets. Blue plastic bins are visible to the right. The foreground has a partial view of a metal rack.

objects.label: orange and black forklift
objects.observation: The forklift is centrally located, parked on the concrete floor. Its forks are down, and it faces slightly left. It's surrounded by shelves and pallets. No visible attachments or controls are detailed.

objects.label: orange metal shelving unit
objects.observation: Tall, multi-tiered shelves extend from left to right, filled with stacked cardboard boxes. They appear bolted to the wall or floor. Some items are partially obscured by other objects.

objects.label: blue plastic bin
objects.observation: A large blue bin stands on the right side of the frame, next to another smaller blue bin. Both are freestanding on the concrete floor. Their contents are not visible.

objects.label: cardboard boxes
objects.observation: Numerous boxes are stacked on shelves and on wooden pallets on the floor. They vary in size and color, mostly brown. Some have labels or tape visible.

objects.label: wooden pallets
objects.observation: Several wooden pallets are on the floor, some holding boxes. One is directly under the forklift. They rest on the concrete floor without visible supports.
